longDescription:
# Nugget-O-Verse

## 🚀 Overview
Nugget-O-Verse is a pedagogy-driven learning engine designed to transform static educational content into structured, interactive, self-paced learning experiences.

Instead of treating education as a digital library of videos and PDFs, Nugget-O-Verse breaks content into atomic learning units called **Nuggets**, which can be dynamically assembled into meaningful learning flows called **Experiences**.

---

## 🧩 What is a Nugget?
A Nugget is the smallest consumable unit of learning content. It can be:

- Note
- Image
- Video
- Audio
- Single Choice Question (SCC)
- Multiple Choice Question (MCC)
- Fill in the Blanks (FIB)
- Label the Image (LTI)
- Subjective Question
- True/False
- Match the Column
- Table Nugget
- Scratch the Image

Each Nugget is:
- Tagged by category, subject, chapter, topic
- Configurable with XP rewards
- Configurable with Timers (multiples of 15 seconds)

---

## 🎯 Experience Engine
An **Experience** is a curated sequence of Nuggets designed to serve a learning objective.

Examples:
- Test Series (collection of question nuggets)
- Video Series
- Pedagogical Blend (video + note + question)
- Notes File (note + image nuggets)

This allows modular learning flow construction instead of static content consumption.

---

## 🏆 Gamification Layer
- XP points awarded for correct answers
- Timer-based reward scaling
- Structured engagement loops

XP values are configurable in multiples of 15.

---

## 🧠 Problem It Solves
Traditional schooling suffers from:
- One-size-fits-all pacing
- Lack of personalization
- Low engagement
- Memorization-based learning

Most EdTech apps act as digital libraries.

Nugget-O-Verse shifts the focus from content availability to **pedagogy-driven delivery**.

> Content can be pirated. Pedagogy cannot.

---

## 🏗 System Design Contribution
- Designed structured content schema for 13+ nugget types
- Built scalable question management backend
- Implemented XP and timer logic engine
- Created tag-based taxonomy for content filtering
- Enabled admin-based experience construction

---

## 💡 Impact
This system enables:
- Self-paced learning
- Structured engagement
- Interactive retention-driven content delivery
- Modular content scalability

Nugget-O-Verse lays the foundation for building pedagogy-first digital learning systems.
